facts.text: Feature Telemetry module simplifies app health monitoring and tracks feature uptake using three event types: LogUsage for successful feature use, LogError for explicit errors, and LogUptake for…
Must implement Telemetry Logger interface in an extension codeunit and register it via OnRegisterTelemetryLogger event subscriber, one per app publisher.
LogUptake tracks four uptake states: Undiscovered, Discovered (page opens), Set up (user configures), and Used (user attempts feature). Calling with Undiscovered resets uptake state.
LogUptake may make database transactions and requires PerformWriteTransactionsInASeparateSession set to true when called from try function.
Custom dimensions include extension info, user role, environment type, client type, and for errors: stack trace and error text describing the issue.
If no telemetry logger registered for publisher, server logs event AL0000G7K to environment telemetry indicating app sending data without registered logger.
